_about: Lite courtroom: which numbered PIIND data-point question (1-based, order of PIIND.questions.txt in the soic-ladder repo, branch piind-questions-v5) belongs to which issue (names and sections come from issues.json). decisive = the one question that decides the section. Question 49 (FIFA) is a control and is in no issue. Issues with no answered question are 'no data'. Written by hand; I9 and I10 have no data-point question, so they stay 'no data'.
